His second was a long-duration stay aboard the International Space Station (ISS) as a Flight Engineer for Expedition 15; for this mission he was launched in the Soyuz TMA-10 spacecraft. In April 2017, Yurchikhin launched on Soyuz MS-04 for the fifth spaceflight of his career, a six-month mission to the ISS as part of Expedition 51 and 52, for which he was the Commander.»
[6] «Expedition 25 | Expedition 25 was the 25th long-duration mission to the International Space Station (ISS).  Expedition 25 began with the Soyuz TMA-18 undocking on 25 September 2010.
